/- Prove that if $H$ is a subgroup of $G$ of index $n$, then there is a normal subgroup $K$ of $G$
such that $K\leq H$ and $[G:K]\leq n!$-/
theorem subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) 
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  refine ⟨H.normalCore, Subgroup.normalCore_normal H, Subgroup.normalCore_le H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := hH
    have hFinQ : Finite (G ⧸ H) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcard]; exact hn)
    have hker : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker H
    have hInj := QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))
    have hFinP : Finite (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := inferInstance
    have hFinK : Finite (G ⧸ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker) :=
      Finite.of_injective _ hInj
    show H.normalCore.index ≠ 0
    rw [Subgroup.index, hker]
    exact Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨inferInstance, hFinK⟩
  · have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := hH
    have hFinQ : Finite (G ⧸ H) := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcard]; exact hn)
    have hker : H.normalCore = (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker :=
      Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker H
    have hInj := QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))
    have hLe : Nat.card (G ⧸ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker) ≤
        Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ hInj
    have hPerm : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = n.factorial := by
      sorry
    show H.normalCore.index ≤ n.factorial
    rw [Subgroup.index, hker]
    calc Nat.card (G ⧸ (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H)).ker)
        ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := hLe
      _ = n.factorial := hPerm

/-- If \( n \) is odd and \( n \geq 3 \), show that the identity is the only element of
\( D_{2n} \) which commutes with all elements of \( D_{2n} \). -/
theorem DihedralGroup.centralizer_eq_bot {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (h : n ≥ 3) :
    Subgroup.centralizer ⊤ = (⊥ : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n)) := by
  ext g
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff, Subgroup.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
    have hn2 : ¬ (n ∣ 2) := by
      intro hd
      have : n ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hd
      omega
    cases g with
    | r i =>
      have hcom : DihedralGroup.r i * DihedralGroup.sr 0 =
                  DihedralGroup.sr 0 * DihedralGroup.r i := hg _ (Subgroup.mem_top _)
      simp [DihedralGroup.r_mul_sr, DihedralGroup.sr_mul_r] at hcom
      -- hcom : -i = i, i.e., 2*i = 0
      have h2i : (2 : ZMod n) * i = 0 := by
        have : i + i = 0 := by
          have := hcom
          linear_combination -this
        have h2eq : (2 : ZMod n) * i = i + i := by ring
        rw [h2eq]; exact this
      -- Since n is odd, gcd(2,n) = 1, so 2 is a unit in ZMod n
      have hcop : Nat.Coprime 2 n := by
        rcases hn with ⟨k, hk⟩
        subst hk
        simp [Nat.Coprime, Nat.coprime_two_left, Nat.odd_iff]
        omega
      have h2unit : IsUnit (2 : ZMod n) := by
        rw [ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime]
        exact hcop
      have hi : i = 0 := by
        rcases h2unit with ⟨u, hu⟩
        have : u.inv * ((2 : ZMod n) * i) = u.inv * 0 := by rw [h2i]
        rw [mul_zero] at this
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← hu, u.inv_val, one_mul] at this
        exact this
      subst hi
      rfl
    | sr i =>
      have hcom : DihedralGroup.sr i * DihedralGroup.r 1 =
                  DihedralGroup.r 1 * DihedralGroup.sr i := hg _ (Subgroup.mem_top _)
      simp [DihedralGroup.sr_mul_r, DihedralGroup.r_mul_sr] at hcom
      -- hcom gives 1 - i = i + 1 or similar, leading to 2 = 0
      exfalso
      have h2 : (2 : ZMod n) = 0 := by
        have := hcom
        linear_combination -this
      rw [show (2 : ZMod n) = ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod n) from by norm_num] at h2
      rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h2
      exact hn2 h2
  · rintro rfl
    intro x _
    rw [one_mul, mul_one]
